subject: general
question: Which of the following revolutionary journals was NOT published abroad?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Yugantar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Y****ugantar Patrika** was a Bengali revolutionary newspaper founded in 1906 in Calcutta by Barindra Kumar Ghosh, Abhinash Bhattacharya and Bhupendranath Dutt.
 
• It was founded by **Madan Mohan Malviya. **
 
• **Bhupendranath Dutt** served as the editor of the Yugantar newspaper till his arrest in **1907.**
 
• It also published articles from a variety of noted Bengali revolutionaries including** Barindra Kumar Ghosh and Aurobindo Ghosh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Madan's Talwar, later known as The Talvar, was an **early-20th-century Indian Nationalist periodical published in Berlin.**
 
• The Free Hindustan is described as "An Organ of Freedom, and of Political, Social and spiritual Reform," published in Vancouver. 
 
• **Shyamaji Krishnavarma**, founding father of the India House organization in Highgate, began to supply and edit The Indian Sociologist in January 1905.
 
• The Indian Sociologist of September 1908, published in London. The journal was edited by** Shyamji Krishnavarma from 1905 to 1914.**
